paragraphs: Mentioned in Gittin 14b and 26a. The Gemara asks whether he was a Nasi or spoke in the Nasi’s name.[^1]

notes.text: יד: and כו. give Gittin 14b/26a under the colon/period convention, with there continuing the same tractate and no independently checked named edition. The source itself leaves open whether Nasi is Shimon’s office or belongs to the authority he reports. The full Nasi designation is preserved, without settling that question or expanding the abbreviated personal title beyond R'.
